newsitem.title: USA: Digital maintains patent claim against Intel.
newsitem.headline: Digital maintains patent claim against Intel.

text.p: In a response to Intel Corp's patent suit, Digital Equipment Corp said on Tuesday it continues to maintain that Intel has "unlawfully used" Digital's patented technolgy.

"Intel's action is a typical step for a company that has been sued for patent infringement," Digital said in a statement. "When we receive a copy of their filing, we will study it and be able to respond appropriately."
The Intel's claim, "should not obscure the basic issue between the companies -- Intel has unlawfully used Digital's patented technology," the company said.
Intel announced earlier that it had filed a lawsuit against Digital, claiming Digital infringed upon 14 patents related to Pentium computer chips.
Digital had filed a patent infringement lawsuit in May against Intel for technology that claimed Intel stole its technology for the Pentium processor.
